mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS requests, IFNULL(SUM(status = 'SUCCESS'), 0) AS successCount, IFNULL(SUM(status <> 'SUCCESS'), 0) AS failedCount, IFNULL(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) AS promptTokens, IFNULL(SUM(completion_tokens), 0) AS completionTokens, IFNULL(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(duration_ms)), 0) AS avgDurationMs FROM ai_usage_record WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to}

SELECT DATE(created_at) AS `date`, COUNT(*) AS requests, IFNULL(SUM(status = 'SUCCESS'), 0) AS successCount, IFNULL(SUM(status <> 'SUCCESS'), 0) AS failedCount, IFNULL(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) AS promptTokens, IFNULL(SUM(completion_tokens), 0) AS completionTokens, IFNULL(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens FROM ai_usage_record WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY `date`

SELECT scene AS scene, provider AS provider, model_name AS modelName, COUNT(*) AS requests, IFNULL(SUM(status = 'SUCCESS'), 0) AS successCount, IFNULL(SUM(status <> 'SUCCESS'), 0) AS failedCount, IFNULL(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) AS promptTokens, IFNULL(SUM(completion_tokens), 0) AS completionTokens, IFNULL(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(duration_ms)), 0) AS avgDurationMs FROM ai_usage_record WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} GROUP BY scene, provider, model_name ORDER BY SUM(total_tokens) DESC
